com.vector.cfg.dom.runtimesys.groovy.api

Interface ICommunicationElementUnmapper


  • @PublishedApi(value=ADDITIONS_ALLOWED)
 @PublishedApiDomain(value=AUTOMATION_IF)
public interface ICommunicationElementUnmapper
    ICommunicationElementUnmapper provides an Api to control and evaluate the unmapping of ICommunicationElements from their mapped IAbstractSignalInstances.

    • Method Detail

      • evaluateMatches

        @PublishedMethod
void evaluateMatches(@Nonnull
                                       groovy.lang.Closure<java.util.List<IAbstractSignalInstance>> code)
        evaluateMatches(Closure) allows to evaluate and change the results of the communication elements which are about to be unmapped from signal instances.

        For each selected communication element the provided closure is called: Parameters are the current handled communication element and a list of all mapped signal instances (respecting the selectTargetSignalInstances(Closure) predicates). The return value must be a list of signal instances which are mapped to the current handled communication element.

        Parameters:
        code - The code to evaluate mapped signal instances which should be unmapped from the previously selected communication elements.
